checks.explanation: There is not enough specific public confirmation of a formal SpaceX-Google compute sales arrangement to verify this claim.
SpaceX's 2026 revenue is projected in the $22-30 billion range, closely matching the predicted $25-30 billion figure, up from about $18.7 billion in 2025.
This prediction concerns SpaceX's 2027 and 2028 revenue, years that have not yet occurred.
This prediction concerns terrestrial data center revenue by 2030-2032, a timeframe far in the future.

As of mid-2026, SpaceX had not yet achieved rapid same-day multi-flight Starship reusability; the upper-stage tower catch milestone was still pending, so this window has not been definitively resolved.
This prediction concerns commercial orbital data centers arriving between late 2028 and early 2030, a timeframe not yet reached.
No global credit crisis has occurred as of 2026 despite periodic Japanese government bond yield spikes and yen carry trade concerns.
No US dollar crisis has occurred; the dollar has remained the dominant global reserve currency.
There is no evidence the Trump administration has tacitly signaled acceptance of an eventual Chinese takeover of Taiwan; official US policy has continued to emphasize support for Taiwan's defense.
